title: Staggered
use_cases: Use when developing romance novels or character-focused narratives with separate initial trajectories
Implement when characters function independently without immediate causal links between their events
Configure when designing story structures where multiple protagonists converge only at the climax
content: Another option is to stagger the structure. Staggered structuring means that plot points for each character happen at different times and with no causality between them. In a romance, Character A’s inciting incident might be losing their job (forcing them to move), while Character B’s is losing a roommate and thus needing to find a new one. It’s likely that the story won’t remain staggered throughout; the characters may come together for at least the climax. But it’s worth keeping in mind that staggering a plot point is an option.
